glossary.ja: オーガニック・エナジー
glossary.role: The life-energy produced by Orphan and the Antibodies (Brain Powerds and Grand Chers); researched by the Isami family
Drake Luft's knight commander and Show Zama's former superior and rival; later fights masked as the Black Knight (黒騎士).
glossary.personality: Proud and capable commander respected by his men; grows obsessed with defeating Show after repeated humiliation.

glossary.role: Drake Luft's flagship aura battleship; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
Holy Warrior from the second group summoned by Drake (said to be from Dublin, Ireland); enemy ace who pilots Leprechaun and is the first to go 'Hyper'
glossary.personality: Violent, impulsive and bloodthirsty; enjoys destruction. Her enormous, unstable Aura Power mirrors what Sho could have become.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Ancient precursor civilisation; the found song/poem plates are judged to be Protoculture artefacts.
Class of insect-like Byston Well mecha fielded by the Drake Army and Show's side.
Aura battleship of Queen Ciela Lapana (Kingdom of Na)

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Race/faction of giant humanoid warriors; main antagonists.
Anti-Orphan battleship (carrier with a pyramid superstructure); base of the Brain Powerd pilots
The large rainbow disc plates that Orphan produces and that spawn Antibodies. Plural 'B-Plates'.
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
Heavily armed Drake army Aura Battler; Jeryll's unit in ACE2
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers

Daba's rival. Ambitious country noble from Koam who joins the Poseidal military (under Chai Char, later one of the Thirteen); commands the Slender Skala, finally sides with Daba to rescue Quwasan. Pilots Ashura Temple, A-Taul, Bat-Shu in ACE2.
glossary.personality: Pompous and vain but sincere, warm-hearted and quick to fall in love; naive and comically airheaded, a rival with a sense of honor.

glossary.role: The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
Earth Federation captain (Captain, 大佐) of the assault carrier Albion; leads the pursuit of the stolen GP02.
glossary.personality: Grizzled veteran with a commanding presence and keen tactical mind; relies on his own judgement and sense of right and wrong.

glossary.role: Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: ND-001 Nadesico, Nergal's battleship
Orphan's disc plates sought by the Reclaimers; ALSO (crossover) inscribed plates carrying a Zentradi/Protoculture song.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).
Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: Masked identity of Burn Bunnings, Drake's former commander, after Sho defeats him; Sho's rival; pilots Zwarth and Galava in ACE2
glossary.personality: Once proud and respected, now bitter and obsessed with revenge on Sho. Cold, theatrical, and hides his face behind a mask.

54.evidence: brief: '私は、ナの国の女王、シーラ・ラパーナです。'

#c[5E8FD8]ノヴィス・ノア#cからは以上です。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)><im(15)><im(16)>Please treat your sister kindly.
She is your precious family, after all.

<op(54,1)><sp(2)><im(17)>地上の皆さん、このたびはご協力いただき、
心より感謝いたします。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)><im(17)>People of the surface, we offer our heartfelt gratitude
for your generous cooperation on this occasion.

<op(54,1)><sp(2)><im(18)>While we were able to halt #c[BE5050]Drake#c's ambitions,

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op25_07. Covers the finale of Phase 5 combat with Drake's death in Will Wips, the rescue of civilians from Orphan including Yuu's parents and Gabriddge, Jonathan's reunion with his mother Anshalan, the duels and demises of Jeril Kuchibi and Burn Bunnings (strictly named as Black Knight where indicated), and the first part of the debriefing by Irene Carrier and Queen Ciela regarding the Zentradi memory plate.
